notes.title: Akupara Games Celebrates 8 Year with Sales and Livestream
notes.notes:
Hey Akuparians! Guess what, it’s our birthday!,

Akupara Games is turning 8 years old and to celebrate, we have put [i]Keep in Mind: Remastered[/i] on sale for 63% off! Be sure to grab those deals, check out our lovely event page, and check out the sales! Maybe the game you’ve been waiting for is waiting for you here, with a crisp sale to match. 
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/akuparagames8thanniversarysale 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32079654/1b810888a3baac10bb6e47830de98f6cfaa88b2c.png[/img]

Also, to celebrate, we will be hosting a multi-hour stream with tons of activities, announcements, and more! Stream is starting at 11:45 PM PDT! We really hope to see you there - and here’s to another year of publishing your favorite indie games on the market
https://www.twitch.tv/akuparagames  

- Riv otter

notes.title: Soundtrack Now Downloading Correctly
notes.notes:
Hey! Some who purchased the soundtrack DLC were not receiving their files.

This should now be fixed for everyone, and you'll notice a 9.5 MB download.

The files by default will be found "Steam > steamapps > common > Keep In Mind > Soundtrack".

Happy listening!

notes.title: Keep in Mind: Remastered - Now Available!
notes.notes:
Happy Launch Day, everyone!

Today is the day that we are releasing Keep in Mind: Remastered. We hope you enjoy the game and we hope it sparks conversation about the heavier topics of depression, alcoholism, and grief that so many of us battle with every single day. Mental health is one of the most important factors in life. We hope that by telling this story we can help others open up about their own stories in order to foster a supportive community.

Keep in Mind: Remastered’s story is derived from the creators Ian Melinn and Cherylynn Lima’s own personal experiences with alcoholism and grief. The main character Jonas is inspired by both Ian and Cherylynn’s fathers, and the themes of the game from their own reflections on the experiences they’ve had. Since the release of the first rendition of Keep in Mind, many have been motivated by the games message to tell their own stories. We’ve seen players seek and give help to others, and we’ve seen them raise the discussion on self-love. Once again, we hope you enjoy the game, and we hope that you too will try to foster the light in your own life. 

All of Akupara Games’ profits from Keep in Mind will be donated to Child's Play, a charity which focuses on improving the lives of children in hospitals by providing toys and video games. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32079654/d738ae473aed926a20dcb2452952bab96e4c91a2.png[/img]

notes.title: Keep in Mind: Remastered Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are so incredibly excited to announce that Little Moth Games and Akupara Games have partnered up to re-release our hit story-driven game, Keep in Mind: Remastered on Steam, iOS, and Android on March 8, 2018!

Additionally, Akupara Games will be donating their profits from Keep in Mind: Remastered to Child's Play, a charity supporting over 140 Children’s Hospitals world wide. Child's Play seeks to improve the lives of children and teens in pediatric hospitals and other child welfare facilities through the kindness and generosity of the gamer community and the power of play.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32079654/42f7dae20116afef109cace4174f94c3754148dc.png[/img]
